results.passage:
# REV original NEO and NEO 550 motor masses

REV's 2019 sheet REV-21-1650-DS-01 gives the original NEO a nominal mass of 425 g, an 8 mm keyed shaft, 35 mm of exposed shaft and an integrated encoder. The sheet pictures the wires and describes them as motor features. It gives no mass tolerance, separate wire masses or explicit weighing boundary. The product page for the later V1.1 also gives 425 g. The mass coincidence leaves the revision-specific shaft geometry and key fit as separate questions. [[raw/clippings/REV original NEO 2019 motor specifications.md]] · [[2024-rev-ground-drive-and-wheel-interfaces]]

REV's 2020 sheet REV-21-1651-DS-01 gives the NEO 550 a nominal mass of 142 g, a 35 mm housing diameter, 44.5 mm body length and 16 AWG motor wires. Its encoder is integrated. The external controller, driven hardware and mounting fasteners have their own mass boundaries. A planning ledger can replace an identified motor occurrence at the published mass and carry a separate allowance for the actual outfitted condition. Neither sheet establishes the total weight of a drive module or the rotor's inertia. [[raw/clippings/REV NEO 550 motor datasheet.md]]

# NEO 550 mounting depth and button screws

REV lists M3 × 0.5 mounting holes with 5 mm maximum screw engagement on the NEO 550. The UltraPlanetary motor-plate assembly instructions specify two M3 × 8 mm button heads. Measure the clamped thickness from the seated underside of the head to the motor face before selecting the screw. Subtract that thickness from the actual underhead length and check the remaining penetration against the exact motor. [[raw/clippings/NEO 550 Brushless Motor.md]] · [[raw/clippings/rev-up-three-stage-assembly.md]]

TR Fastenings lists TR00004819-000 as a 6 mm M3 ISO 7380 button screw in A2 stainless steel. This identifies a shorter catalog option. Material strength, preload, allowable engagement, cartridge-side head clearance and actual purchased CAD are separate selection criteria. The partial capture contains the specification and article identity. Its extraction warnings concern the enquiry and download sections. [[raw/clippings/M3 x 6mm Button Head Hexagon Socket Drive Screw.md]]

# WPILib 2024 NEO motor models and REV MAXSwerve template gearing

WPILib v2024.3.2 defines the following motor-shaft parameters for one motor at nominal 12 V. The source constructor derives resistance from stall current, torque constant from stall torque divided by stall current, and speed constant from the free shaft speed divided by the voltage remaining after the resistance drop at free current. results.passage:
Keep the existing NEO V1.1 product and relative-dynamometer profiles separate from this theoretical NEO 2.0 profile. Do not overwrite the current WPILib getNEO baseline or mix new stall numbers with an older profile merely to obtain a preferred result. A new electrical model needs explicit device/configuration provenance, consistent quantities, numerical review and independently measured validation. Similar free speed or vendor compatibility wording does not establish identical torque, loss, thermal, sensor or firmware behavior.

No exact alloy, radial/axial load capacity, tested continuous operating envelope or candidate calibration was established here. No motor was selected, bought, installed or substituted in code/CAD. Historical 2024/2025 applicability is not inferred from a current product page. All physical acceptance gates remain unchanged. See [motor model adapters](motor-model-adapter-boundaries.md), [manufacturer evidence](component-manufacturer-evidence.md) and [shaft support limits](bearing-shaft-interface-boundaries.md).
